name: immersive_3_2
character: Discrete 3.2 (project layout): left, right and centre at ear level with two low-frequency channels, LFE1 and LFE2. Not a broadcast standard layout.
label: 3.2 (project layout: L C R + LFE1 LFE2)
sources: Project-defined layout: ITU-R BS.2051 has no three-front layout with two low-frequency channels (knowledgebase/sound-design/layout-3-2.md, not verified against the Recommendation), so no format conformance is claimed
ITU-R BS.1770: loudness is measured on the delivered channels with the layout's channel weights, both low-frequency channels excluded (`loudness.method`: bs1770_layout)
The linked limiter, the fold-down band limit and the -3.0 dBTP ceiling are copied from the 5.1 target and are starting values, not measured on a three-front room
